checks.explanation: AI assistants have genuinely expanded beyond coding into office-document generation and broader knowledge work in 2026, but there's no dataset confirming a measurable 'productivity boom' at the scale implied.

AI coding assistants have evolved into more general agentic personal-assistant tools connected to email and files in 2026, but 'commonplace' adoption at the mainstream-consumer level remains unverified.

The US retains a lead across chips and semiconductor manufacturing equipment, but China has closed the gap faster than these specific margins suggest: Huawei now holds over half of China's domestic AI chip market and DeepSeek has demonstrated competitive frontier-adjacent models despite the chip gap, complicating a clean '6 months / 2 years / 5 years' framing.

sources.title: AI Chip Export Controls 2026: How Huawei Grabbed 50%+ of China's Market
